metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Remove the Lettuce 5.1 javaagent module so the Lettuce 5.0 integration covers all supported 5.0+ clients. Lettuce 4.x and the standalone Lettuce library remain supported.

To keep Lettuce instrumentation disabled, replace `otel.instrumentation.lettuce-5.1.enabled=false` with `otel.instrumentation.lettuce.enabled=false`; the version-specific 5.1 selector is no longer supported.

Remove command-encoding event support from both the Java agent and the standalone library. Library callers must remove `LettuceTelemetryBuilder.setEncodingSpanEventsEnabled`; there is no replacement API:

```java
// Before
builder.setEncodingSpanEventsEnabled(true).build();

// After
builder.build();
```

The Java agent no longer supports `otel.instrumentation.lettuce.experimental.command-encoding-events.enabled`. Neither the agent nor the standalone library emits `redis.encode.start` or `redis.encode.end` span events.

For Lettuce 5.1+, agent telemetry now uses `io.opentelemetry.lettuce-5.0` instead of `io.opentelemetry.lettuce-5.1`. Update any filters or dashboards that match the old instrumentation scope.
